text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Daruma-san ga koronda! —Ah! You just 
moved, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! And here I thought I had it in the 
bag! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're terrible at this~. If you flinch 
that easily, of course you're gonna lose.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
What's your deal, lady, who are you 
anyway! If you're gonna talk all big like 
that, you better be good at Red Light, 
Green Light!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course I did! I'm the genius magical 
girl Sweepy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
A-Awesome! You really didn't stumble at 
all! Big sis, how did ya do that!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, how...? Once I decide 
not to move, nothing can budge me. Push me 
or pull me, I'm not moving an inch♪

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, that was amazing! Teach me the 
trick to doing that, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, this is a special treat♪ Yours 
truly, Sweepy, will turn you all into 
Daruma-san masters♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho became so absorbed in playing 
with the children that she completely 
forgot about her training.
